svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print six in PETG standing upright: head 12 mm across, 24 mm tall,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a spigot 6.3 mm across and 12 mm long below it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The spigot drops into any 6.6 mm plain hole; the head is the stop.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: For heavy use, press a 6 mm steel dowel into a 5.8 mm hole

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: printed through the head instead of the printed spigot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the spigot drops into a plain hole by hand and does not

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rock more than about 0.3 mm at the top.
